description: Zero-damage threshold T on the JRC flood curve: depth d <= T gives no damage, d > T gives JRC(d). Defaults apply only when the site survey has no measured value. Every value cites a source id in 'sources'.

SILL_DEF.blocks_outside_depth: 5 cm — the JRC curve's own zero point, i.e. the existing curve unchanged
SILL_DEF.basis: No Korean general value for the sill height of a basement opening was found (F1), so no extra protection is assumed without a measurement.

RAMP_W.blocks_outside_depth: none — only sets the pump head ΔH (wider ramp, smaller ΔH)
RAMP_W.basis: 주차장법 시행규칙 제6조제1항제5호: ramp lane width 2-lane straight 6 m or more.

WEIR.basis: Broad-crested weir Q = C·B·H^1.5, C = sqrt(g)·(2/3)^1.5 (critical-depth theory, losses ignored — upper bound of inflow).

BOARD_PLAN.blocks_outside_depth: 60 cm — used only in the 'if installed' value
BOARD_PLAN.basis: Assumption: expected depth 0.3 m + freeboard 0.3 m (S2 제7조). The expected depth is an assumption; S1 제4조 sets it from flood traces / maps.

sources.R1: Huizinga, J., de Moel, H., Szewczyk, W. (2017). Global flood depth-damage functions. JRC Technical Report EUR 28552 EN. doi:10.2760/16510
sources.R2: CLIMADA-petals 6.2.0 ImpfRiverFlood.from_jrc_region_sector; Aznar-Siguan, G., Bresch, D.N. (2019). CLIMADA v1. Geosci. Model Dev. 12, 3085-3097
sources.R3: Scussolini, P. et al. (2016). FLOPROS: an evolving global database of flood protection standards. Nat. Hazards Earth Syst. Sci. 16, 1049-1061 — overtopping above the standard floods with the full depth
sources.H1: Henderson, F.M. (1966). Open Channel Flow. Macmillan; Chow, V.T. (1959). Open-Channel Hydraulics. McGraw-Hill — broad-crested weir
sources.L1: 주차장법 시행규칙 제6조제1항제5호 (경사로 차로 너비). Confirmed via 국토교통부 질의회신; current text on law.go.kr to be checked (2024-09 amendment)
sources.S1: 행정안전부고시 제2024-88호 「지하공간 침수 방지를 위한 수방기준」
sources.S2: 국토교통부고시 제2023-483호 「물막이설비 설치 기술기준」 제7조 (여유고 0.3 m)
sources.K2: 조재웅, 최우정 (2011). 지하공간 내수침수피해 원인 — river / coastal water backflows, so pumps are not counted for RF / CF
sources.F1: Not found: a Korean general or standard value for the sill height of a basement opening (searched S1, S2, 주차장법, web)
